theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_ga_set_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (g : Euclid m → Euclid k) (D A : Set (Euclid m)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g D → MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → μHE[m] ((fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) '' A) = ∫⁻ w in A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).det))
